rule: Spawner = one position plus a creature id; the population and delay template is a DB row (not in box). Spawner is active only if a player is inside its test radius (cached 10 s). Gate: spawn flag must be clear; population cap = players in radius, clamped to template min and max. Spawn creates one NPC per template entry. Death queues a respawn at death time plus a random respawn time drawn from the template's min and max; the body is removed DespawnTime s after the despawn order (default 20 s) plus 300 s if loot remains. Respawn event clears the spawn flag. Return home: after a chase with an empty aggro table and no path points, walk to home at speed param 3, then resume the follow-path behaviour. Idle priority: aggro, alert, follow path, follow nearest NPC, default.

data_fields.unit: s (code default 20; template value not read)

keep: Spawner as a position plus creature id, with population and delay in separate data.
Player-presence radius gates spawning and despawning; presence cached for a short time.
Population cap follows the player count near the spawner.
Death queues a respawn after a random delay drawn from data; corpse linger 20 s, plus 300 s when loot remains.
Leader flag and formation offsets for groups of 2 to 3 members (101 of 158 groups).
Return home after a chase, then resume the route.
Idle priority order: aggro, alert, follow path, follow nearest NPC, default.
change: Cap check inside the spawn loop, not once before it (NpcSpawner.cs 932, 957-988).
Weight used on the normal spawn path, not only the random path (NpcSpawner.cs 972, 1245).
Implement the spawn cooldown: _lastSpawnTime is never assigned (NpcSpawner.cs 47, 164-170).
Fix the schedule despawn branch that returns true for in-window NPCs (NpcSpawner.cs 1093-1099, 1123, 1132).
Spawn the group as a group: leader first, members at offsets; SpawnNpcGroup is a stub (NpcSpawnerNpc.cs 146-148).
Store the respawn roll on the NPC, not on the shared spawner (NpcSpawnerNpc.cs 123).
Sweep spawners that hold live NPCs even when no player is near (WorldManager.cs 183-184; NpcSpawner.cs 87-91).
Clear the spawn flag when population drops below the cap, not only on a respawn event (SpawnManager.cs 1056; NpcSpawner.cs 196).
Cap attackers at 3 in the engine for groups of 4 or more (55 of 158 groups).
look_test: Sandbox zone: one camp of three (leader plus two followers at -2 m offsets), one two-member guard pair on a six-point path that walks home after a chase, one spawn point with a 60 s respawn and 20 s corpse linger. Dom walks it for five minutes at 375 wide: can he tell leader from followers; does the guard walk home without teleporting; does a cleared camp refill with a visible gap; does a corpse with loot stay readable. Second pass at 300 s respawn. Our test values, not donor values.
